name: Product gallery
description: A main image with a thumbnail rail, a zoom affordance and an image counter, where clicking a thumb swaps the main image.

name: Buy box
description: The full right-hand column: eyebrow, title, star rating with a review link, price, short description, add to cart, and a save action.

name: Variant selector
description: Edition pills and gift wrap swatches as radio groups, with selected, not yet released and sold out states kept visually distinct.

name: Quantity stepper
description: Minus and plus either side of a number input, floored at 1 and capped at the order limit, with a disabled state at each bound.

name: Price block
description: Every price presentation in one place: single, sale against RRP, per unit, from price with an add-on, and instalments.

name: Stock and urgency
description: The availability cues: in stock, low stock with a level bar, sold out with a notify action, and a live viewing count.

name: Delivery estimator
description: A postcode check that returns a delivery window and a shipping cost, with a result state and an error state.

name: Sticky add to cart bar
description: The bar that slides in once the buy box scrolls away, carrying a thumb, the title, the price and an add button.

name: Product accordion
description: What's in the box, the details, the ritual, and delivery and returns as native disclosures with an animated chevron marker.

name: Guarantee row
description: A four up row of icon, label and one line of reassurance for delivery, origin, coverage and secure checkout.

name: Buy together
description: The deck and its gift add-ons bought together at a combined price, with a checkbox per item that recalculates the total and the button.

name: Cross sell rail
description: A horizontally scrollable goes well with rail of compact cards, each carrying a quick add button and snap alignment.

name: Specification table
description: A two column spec table with a locations index link that opens a native dialog holding the twelve landmarks.
